tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows do not identify a unique law: input responses are nonmonotone despite the coarse monotone-concave signature, and all rows share the same horizon and several covariates. A targeted open-branch probe is available at cost 2.0 and can distinguish competing mechanisms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: author a stationary smooth model from the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations at one horizon and fixed x_now, u_past, and mem_conv leave substantial ambiguity among the coupled siphon, Haldane, and multiplicative models; the target horizon is long relative to the characteristic tau scale.
A broad discriminating probe is the lower-cost targeted next step; finer sampling is not yet justified.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and would not resolve the model ambiguity.
The source note recommends it above s_grad 2.36, but it is not among the available probe keys.
